rdmorganiser.title: ORCID
rdmorganiser.description: Queries the expanded-search endpoint of the [ORCID public API](https://info.orcid.org/documentation/api-tutorials/api-tutorial-searching-the-orcid-registry/).

rdmorganiser.title: ROR
rdmorganiser.description: Queries the expanded-search endpoint of the [ROR API](https://ror.readme.io/docs/rest-api).

rdmorganiser.title: GND
rdmorganiser.description: Queries the API for the Gemeinsame Normdatei (GND) at https://lobid.org/gnd.

rdmorganiser.title: Wikidata
rdmorganiser.description: Queries the Wikidata Search API at https://www.wikidata.org/w/api.php.

rdmorganiser.title: re3data
rdmorganiser.description: Queries [re3data.org](https://www.re3data.org/) for repositories that match the research field of the project (as given by the `project/research_field/title` attribute).

rdmorganiser.title: RADAR
rdmorganiser.description: Pushes metadata from RDMO to [RADAR](https://www.radar-service.eu/). Users need to upload the actual data to Zenodo themselves. The export uses [OAUTH 2.0](https://oauth.net/2/), so that users use their respective accounts in both systems.

rdmorganiser.title: Zenodo
rdmorganiser.description: Pushes metadata from RDMO to [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org). Users need to upload the actual data to Zenodo themselves. Uses [OAUTH 2.0](https://oauth.net/2/), so that users use their respective accounts in both systems.

rdmorganiser.title: OpenProject
rdmorganiser.description: Uses [OAUTH 2.0](https://oauth.net/2/), so that users use their respective accounts in both systems.

rdmorganiser.title: GitHub
rdmorganiser.description: Uses [OAUTH 2.0](https://oauth.net/2/), so that users use their respective accounts in both systems.

rdmorganiser.title: GitLab
rdmorganiser.description: Uses [OAUTH 2.0](https://oauth.net/2/), so that users use their respective accounts in both systems.

rdmorganiser.title: MAUS
rdmorganiser.description: SMP Plugins for RDMO, used by the GitHub and GitLab plugins

rdmorganiser.title: Chatbot
rdmorganiser.description: Implements a copilot-style chatbot that has access to all the project information already entered.

rdmorganiser.title: LLM Views
rdmorganiser.description: Provides functions for creating LLM-generated views from the project information entered in RDMO.

shared.title: RDMO Sensor AWI optionset plugin
shared.description: Queries the Sensor Information System of the Alfred-Wegener-Institut, Helmholtz-Zentrum für Polar- und Meeresforschung (AWI). This is an example plugin, to show how to gather information from other systems.
